title: 第五卷四十七兄弟情深第五卷四十六零食
content_zh:
第五卷（四十七）兄弟情深
森智猛地一阵心悸。
那种感觉像是一根冰冷的针从尾椎骨一路扎进颅骨深处，尖锐、精准、毫无预兆。它正在阿尔法努星地心熔核中享用最后几层地核薄膜——那些半透明的、由纯态灵力凝结而成的膜状结构，是行星地核最珍贵的营养层。它已经把这片薄膜啃噬了九成，只要再给它几天时间，它就能彻底吞掉罩在阿尔法努星地核上的最后一层薄膜，从而将整颗行星内部掏空，形成一颗比大哥更完美的黑洞。
但现在它顾不上吃了。它把吞了一半的地核薄膜吐出来，那条丑陋的、布满吸盘的鲇鱼嘴在熔核中剧烈颤抖。它试图与大哥建立联系——这是它们兄弟之间的本能，同源同根，共享同一个主上的恩赐，无论相隔多少光年都能在意识深处触碰彼此。虚空中大哥的气息还在，但越来越弱，弱得像暴风雪中一盏随时会熄灭的油灯。然后它看到了那道剑光。
那是大哥意识消散前最后定格的一帧画面——一道锈红色的剑光，从左上斜劈至右下，剑光背后是一个普通的中年男人。他握剑的手很稳，剑光劈进大哥的身体时他的眼睛是睁着的，没有杀意，没有愤怒，只有一种极沉极深的平静。那平静比剑光本身更让森智恐惧。然后画面断了，大哥的意识从虚空中彻底消失。
森智趴在阿尔法努星地心熔核中，全身的吸盘同时收紧。大哥死了。那个比它更早被主上选中、得到骨片和功法、拥有数百只复眼的大哥，那个骄傲自负、从来不服它“只靠脑子”的大哥——死了。
它没有哭，也哭不出来。但它从喉咙深处发出了一声极低极沉的嘶鸣，那嘶鸣穿过熔核、穿过地幔、穿过阿尔法努星冰蓝的地表，没有人听到。沈轻烟正在宗门治疗室里维持着三个时间静止结界，郑明俊正在后山小屋里削萝卜，铁木在通讯站对着一排排稳定的绿线打了个哈欠。没有人听到一头怪物在四千公里深的脚底下为它死去的大哥发出的哀鸣。
森智在熔核中静止了片刻，然后做出了决定。它幻化成一条极小的鲇鱼——小到比一只苍蝇小，小到任何灵力感知都捕捉不到，从地心熔核中无声滑出，穿过地幔裂缝，穿过地壳断层，穿过阿尔法努星冰原上正在飘落的雪花，穿过大气层，穿过联邦星域边界上仍在闪烁的七色雷云，向渊尘星方向瞬移而去。连颜丙的龙瞳都没有感知到它的存在，七色龙的雷暴没有触发任何预警。它的智力是它与大哥之间最大的区别——大哥靠蛮力，它靠脑子。它知道什么时候该隐身，什么时候该出手，什么时候该像现在这样把自己缩到最小最卑微最不起眼。
它在渊尘星上空望到了大哥的残躯。
那颗正在崩塌的灰色地带里，大哥巨大的、无边无际的暗紫色身躯横亘在虚空中。东东的冷冻之力从内部爆发，冰层从大哥体内向外蔓延，将它的浓雾、复眼、利齿、吸盘全部封冻——不是普通的冰，是吞冰兽从风之眼星暴风雪、东山谷灵石、忘川时间裂隙中积攒了数年的极寒之力。森智能看出来，这股冷冻力不止低温，还带着某种法则层面的封禁，冰层内部连时间流速都变慢了，从内向外封冻住了大哥所有逃逸的途径。而韩昌那一剑更可怕——切口从大哥左肩斜劈至右腰，光滑如镜，切面绵延过去望不到边际，沿着身体的主轴平行切过，像一道被拉长的银线镶在了虚空中。
森智落在大哥残躯的边缘。它没有降落在尸体上，而是停在附近一块崩落的渊尘星地壳碎片上，远远地望着。它不敢靠得太近——那道剑光的余韵还在切口边缘燃烧，暗金色的剑意残留在切面上，即使大哥的灵力已经消散殆尽，剑意依然不散。这剑意的主人杀掉大哥只用了一剑。它把所有残片拼起来，终于拼出了大哥死前完整的画面：东东被吸进去后从内部释放极寒之力瞬间冷冻住大哥全身，利用的是大哥吞噬时口腔内部的防御真空；韩昌只用了一剑，抓住的正是大哥被冻僵后躯体无法分散逃逸的那一瞬间。好计谋，好冷冻力，好强的剑。什么都好，唯一不好的是——大哥被这些好弄死了。
森智没有冲动。它趴在暗紫色地壳碎片上，把自己伪装成一粒不起眼的碎屑，那对细小的鲇鱼眼在黑暗中闪烁着幽冷的光。它开始分析——大哥的实力略逊于自己，但大哥有主上赐的骨片和护心甲，防御力比自己强。大哥被干掉，说明这些人的杀伤力已经达到了能破黑洞级防御的上限。自己的智力远在大哥之上，但硬实力打不过这些人。不能硬碰，必须用脑子。那这次杀大哥的组合拳——计谋、冷冻克制、剑气击杀——缺一不可。只要拆掉其中一环，他们就杀不了自己。
第五卷（四十七）兄弟情深
它开始制定计划。第一步：先不回阿尔法努星，留在渊尘星域观察一段时间。联邦的人刚刚杀了大哥，戒备心最强的时候，不适合动手。它要等他们松懈，等他们以为黑洞的威胁已经解除，等他们庆祝胜利。第二步：暗中完成阿尔法努星地核的吞噬，形成自己的黑洞。它要拆掉东东的冷冻克制——吞冰兽的极寒之力对黑洞级存在有效的前提是能从内部释放，冰封靠的是出其不意，一旦有了防备，黑洞的吸积盘可以在体表形成一层超密质引力盾，冰系灵力根本穿透不了。下次东东再想从内部冻住它，它的体表会先用引力盾把冰系灵力全部弹开，让那个小毛球连它的皮都碰不到。它要拆掉剑神的剑气——韩昌的剑意是意志之力，意志确实吞不掉，但意志可以被消耗。大哥死前那场战斗消耗了剑神的灵力，自爆剑核的意愿已将他的精气神逼至极限。只要多耗几次，剑神的意志迟早会疲惫，再强的剑也会有收鞘的时刻。它也要拆掉阿木的计谋——大哥之所以踩进这个陷阱，是因为天狗军团被安抚、首领被找到，驯兽师破坏了军团同步。森智自己不依赖异兽，它的力量来自黑洞本体，不需要任何坐骑为自己增幅。
它甚至开始思考更深层的问题。联邦那帮人——剑神、剑仙、灵蛇、龙族、驯兽师、战略宗师——他们就像一群蚂蚁，单个弱小，组合起来却能咬死比自己大无数倍的猎物。大哥就死在这种组合上。对付蚂蚁不能踩，越踩它们抱团越紧，要用水淹——用一场全面的、多维度的、同时针对所有环节的洪水，让蚂蚁来不及抱团就被冲散。
它已经有了腹稿。阿尔法努星的地核还剩最后几层薄膜，它要回去完成吞噬，形成黑洞，但在完成之前需要制造一场足够大的混乱来转移联邦的注意力，让他们无暇顾及阿尔法努星正在发生什么。它需要一个诱饵，一个能让联邦把主力全部调过去的饵。它已经有了人选——不是自己，不是大哥的残余部队，是一颗与联邦素无往来的星球。把那里的星主变成自己的傀儡，从另一侧向紫月联邦施压。等联邦主力被吸引过去，它就在阿尔法努星地心完成最后的吞噬。而真正最精彩的一步棋——它要把黑洞的吸积盘伪装成一种联邦从未见过的异兽族群，让它们从阿尔法努星地心涌上地表，模拟出完整的异兽生命周期和社群行为。阿木的驯兽天赋可以安抚天狗，但那是建立在异兽本身具有被安抚的可能之上。如果“异兽”本身就是黑洞的引力场伪装的，它们没有情绪、没有意识、没有可以被安抚的神经，阿木会在第一时间发现自己的天赋失灵——这种打击，比任何物理攻击都更能摧毁一个天才。
等联邦反应过来时，阿尔法努星已经是一颗黑洞了。而它森智，就在黑洞的正中央，等着他们。
他不像大哥那么偏执、残暴，他只想完成主上的大业，但大哥死了，一切都不一样了。它把所有的仇恨都压在心底最深最冷的地方，不让任何一丝情绪波动暴露自己的存在，在那粒不起眼的碎屑里慢慢地、耐心地等待着第一个捕猎目标的出现。
与此同时，紫月联邦会议厅，众人并不知道森智已经来了渊尘星，正伏在大哥的残躯附近冷静地观察着他们。但阿木放下手里的通讯器，眉头微微皱起。从刚才起他一直有一种隐隐的不安——他的大脑是星域最顶尖的，全速运转时能同时处理上百条情报并从中找出隐藏的逻辑链。这种感觉太安静了，暴风雨后的安静和暴风雨前的安静是不一样的。暴风雨后的安静带着释放和松弛，而现在这种安静太完整，像是被什么东西刻意按住了。他说不上来哪里不对，但他的直觉在提示他——这场胜利没问题，可之后的平静呢？
江流云注意到他的表情。他放下茶杯，顺着阿木的目光望向渊尘星方向那片正在消散的灰色地带。“你在想什么？”

阿木沉默了一会才开口：“森灵死了。但它死之前说了几句话——‘主上’、‘骨片’、‘护心甲’。一个能被黑洞尊称为‘主上’的存在，会只给它一块假的骨片吗？如果骨片是假的，说明主上根本不在乎它的死活。它只是一枚棋子。既然是棋子，那么这局棋里就一定还有别的棋子，一枚棋子被吃掉了，剩下的棋子只会藏得更深。一个不在乎棋子死活的主上，才是比黑洞更可怕的存在。”
江流云重新端起茶杯，目光越过会议厅的落地窗，穿过云层和虚空，落在了某处极遥远的、未被任何星图标注过的黑暗里。他没有说出口，但他心里的结论和阿木一样——黑洞森灵只是一枚弃子。真正的对手，还藏在更深的暗处。

Volume 5 (47) Deep Brotherly Love
Senzhi's heart suddenly palpitated.
It felt like a cold needle piercing from the tailbone all the way into the depths of the skull, sharp, precise, and without warning. It is enjoying the last few layers of core films in the core core of Alphanu. Those translucent membrane-like structures condensed by pure spiritual energy are the most precious nutrient layer in the planet's core. It has already eaten through 90% of this film. As long as it is given a few more days, it will be able to completely eat away the last layer of film covering the core of Alphanu, thus hollowing out the entire planet and forming a more perfect black hole than its big brother.
But now it doesn't care about eating. It spat out the half-swallowed core membrane, and the ugly catfish mouth covered with suckers trembled violently in the molten core. It is trying to establish a connection with the elder brother - this is the instinct between their brothers, sharing the same origin and the same gift from the Lord, no matter how many light years apart, they can touch each other deep in the consciousness. The aura of the elder brother in the void is still there, but it is getting weaker and weaker, as weak as an oil lamp that can be extinguished at any time in a snowstorm. Then it saw the sword light.
That was the last frame of the scene before the elder brother's consciousness dissipated - a rusty red sword light, slashing diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Behind the sword light was an ordinary middle-aged man. His hand holding the sword was very steady, and his eyes were open when the sword light struck into his elder brother's body. There was no killing intent, no anger, only a deep and deep calm. That calmness frightened Senzhi more than the sword light itself. Then the screen cut off, and the elder brother's consciousness completely disappeared from the void.
Senzhi was lying in the molten core of Alphanu star, and the suction cups all over his body tightened at the same time. The eldest brother is dead. The elder brother who was chosen by the Lord earlier than it, received the bone fragments and exercises, and had hundreds of compound eyes, the proud and arrogant elder brother who never accepted that it "only relied on brains" - is dead.
It didn't cry and couldn't cry. But it emitted a very low and deep neigh from the depths of its throat, and no one heard the neigh that passed through the molten core, through the mantle, and through the icy blue surface of Alphanu. Shen Qingyan was maintaining three time-stopping barriers in the sect's treatment room, Zheng Mingjun was peeling radishes in the back mountain hut, and Tie Mu yawned at the rows of stable green lines at the communication station. No one heard the cry of a monster four thousand kilometers deep for its dead brother.
Senzhi stood still in the molten core for a moment, and then made a decision. It transformed into a tiny catfish - smaller than a fly, too small to be captured by any spiritual perception. It slipped out of the molten core of the earth's core silently, passed through cracks in the mantle, passed through crustal faults, passed through the falling snowflakes on the Alphanu star ice sheet, passed through the atmosphere, passed through the seven-color thunderclouds that were still flickering on the border of the federal star field, and teleported away in the direction of the Yuanchen star. Even Yan Bing's dragon eyes didn't sense its existence, and the seven-color dragon's thunderstorm didn't trigger any warning. Its intelligence is the biggest difference between it and its elder brother - the elder brother relies on brute force, while it relies on brains. It knows when to be invisible, when to take action, and when to shrink itself to the smallest, humblest and most inconspicuous position as it is now.
It saw the remains of its eldest brother above Yuanchen Star.
In the gray area that was collapsing, Big Brother's huge, endless dark purple body lay across the void. Dongdong's freezing power exploded from the inside, and the ice spread outward from Big Brother's body, freezing its thick fog, compound eyes, sharp teeth, and suckers all - it was not ordinary ice, but the extreme cold power that the ice-eating beast had accumulated for several years from the blizzard of the Eye of Wind Star, the East Valley Spirit Stone, and the time rift in the River of Forgetfulness. Sen Zhizhi could see that this freezing force was not only low-temperature, but also contained some kind of legal blockade. Even the flow of time inside the ice layer slowed down, freezing all the ways of escape for the elder brother from the inside out. And Han Chang's sword was even more terrifying - the incision was from the eldest brother's left shoulder to his right waist., as smooth as a mirror, the section stretches beyond the horizon and cuts parallel to the main axis of the body, like a stretched silver thread set in the void.
Senzhi fell on the edge of his eldest brother's broken body. It did not land on the corpse, but stopped on a nearby fragment of the Yuanchen star's crust that collapsed, looking at it from a distance. It didn't dare to get too close - the afterglow of the sword light was still burning at the edge of the cut, and the dark golden sword intent remained on the cut surface. Even though the elder brother's spiritual power had dissipated, the sword intent still lingered. The master of this sword intention killed his elder brother with just one sword. It put all the fragments together, and finally put together a complete picture of the elder brother before his death: After being sucked in, Dongdong released the extreme cold power from the inside to instantly freeze the elder brother's body, using the defensive vacuum inside the mouth when the elder brother was devouring it; Han Chang only used a sword to capture the moment when the elder brother's body was unable to escape after being frozen. What a strategy, what a freezing power, what a powerful sword. Everything is good, the only bad thing is - the eldest brother was killed by these good things.
Senzhi was not impulsive. It lay on the dark purple crust fragments, disguising itself as an inconspicuous fragment, and its pair of tiny catfish eyes shone coldly in the darkness. It began to analyze - the eldest brother's strength is slightly inferior to itself, but the eldest brother has bone fragments and heart armor given by the Lord, and his defense is stronger than itself. The killing of the eldest brother shows that the lethality of these people has reached the upper limit of being able to break through black hole-level defenses. My intelligence is far superior to that of my elder brother, but I can't beat these people with physical strength. You can't do it head-on, you have to use your brain. Then the combination of punches to kill the eldest brother this time - strategy, freezing restraint, and sword energy kill - are all indispensable. As long as one of the links is removed, they cannot kill themselves.
Volume 5 (47) Deep Brotherly Love
It starts making plans. The first step: Don’t go back to Alpha Nu Star yet, stay in the Yuan Chen Star Domain for observation for a while. The people from the Federation had just killed the eldest brother, and it was not the right time to take action when the guard was at its strongest. It wants to wait for them to relax, for them to think that the threat of black holes has been removed, for them to celebrate their victory. Step two: secretly complete the engulfment of the core of Alphanu and form its own black hole. It wants to remove Dongdong's freezing restraint - the ice-eating beast's extreme cold power must be released from the inside to be effective against black hole-level beings. Ice sealing relies on surprise. Once prepared, the black hole's accretion disk can form a super-dense gravitational shield on the body surface, which ice spiritual power cannot penetrate at all. Next time Dongdong wants to freeze it from the inside, its body surface will first use a gravity shield to deflect all the ice spiritual power, so that the little fur ball can't even touch its skin. It wants to dismantle the sword spirit of the sword god - Han Chang's sword spirit is the power of will. It is true that will cannot be swallowed, but will can be consumed. The battle before the eldest brother's death consumed the sword god's spiritual energy, and his willingness to self-destruct the sword core pushed his energy to the limit. As long as it is used a few more times, the sword god's will will become exhausted sooner or later, and no matter how strong the sword is, there will be a time when it is sheathed. It also wanted to dismantle Amu's plan - the reason why the eldest brother stepped into this trap was because the Tengu Legion was pacified, the leader was found, and the trainer destroyed the legion's synchronization. Senzhi himself does not rely on alien beasts. Its power comes from the black hole itself and does not require any mounts to increase its power.
It even starts to think about deeper issues. The people from the Federation - Sword Gods, Sword Immortals, Spirit Snakes, Dragon Clan, Beast Tamers, Strategy Masters - they are like a group of ants, individually weak, but together they can kill prey countless times larger than themselves. The eldest brother died because of this combination. To deal with ants, you cannot step on them. The more you step on them, the tighter they will become. Flood with water - a comprehensive, multi-dimensional flood that targets all links at the same time, so that the ants will be dispersed before they can cling together.
It already has a rough draft. There are still a few layers of membrane left in the core of Alphanu. It will go back to complete the devouring and form a black hole, but before it can complete it, it needs to create a big enough chaos to divert the attention of the Federation and let himThey have no time to care about what is happening on Alphanu. It needs a bait, a bait that allows the Federation to transfer all its main forces. It already has a candidate - not itself, not Big Brother's remaining troops, but a planet that has no contact with the Federation. Turn the star masters there into their own puppets and put pressure on the Ziyue Federation from the other side. When the main force of the Federation is attracted, it will complete its final devouring in the center of Alpha Nu. And the truly most exciting move is to disguise the black hole's accretion disk as a group of alien beasts that the Federation has never seen before, allowing them to surge from the center of Alphanu to the surface, simulating the complete life cycle and social behavior of the alien beasts. Amu's talent for taming animals can appease the tengu, but that is based on the possibility that the beast itself can be appeased. If the "alien beasts" themselves are disguised by the gravitational field of the black hole, and they have no emotions, no consciousness, and no nerves that can be soothed, Amu will find that his talent is malfunctioning at the first moment - this kind of blow can destroy a genius more than any physical attack.
By the time the Federation reacted, Alphanu was already a black hole. And it, Senzhi, is waiting for them in the center of the black hole.
He is not as paranoid and cruel as his eldest brother. He just wants to complete the Lord's great cause, but after his eldest brother dies, everything is different. It suppresses all its hatred in the deepest and coldest place in its heart, does not let any emotional fluctuations reveal its existence, and slowly and patiently waits for the first hunting target to appear in that inconspicuous crumb.
At the same time, in the Ziyue Federation Conference Hall, everyone did not know that Senzhi had arrived at Yuanchen Star and was crouching near the remains of his eldest brother and observing them calmly. But Amu put down the communicator in his hand and frowned slightly. He has been feeling vaguely uneasy since just now - his brain is the best in the star field, and when running at full speed, it can process hundreds of pieces of information at the same time and find hidden logical links. This feeling is too quiet. The quiet after the storm is different from the quiet before the storm. The silence after the storm was filled with release and relaxation, but now this silence was too complete, as if it was deliberately held down by something. He couldn't tell what was wrong, but his intuition was reminding him - this victory was no problem, but what about the peace afterward?
Jiang Liuyun noticed his expression. He put down the teacup and followed Amu's gaze to the dissipating gray area in the direction of Yuanchen Star. "What are you thinking about?"
Amu was silent for a while before speaking: "The forest spirit is dead. But before it died, it said a few words - 'Lord', 'Bone Piece', 'Heart Armor'. A being that can be called 'Lord' by the black hole will only give it a fake bone fragment? If the bone fragment is fake, it means that the Lord He doesn't care about its life or death at all. Since it is a chess piece, there must be other chess pieces in the game. If one chess piece is eaten, the remaining chess pieces will only be hidden deeper. A master who doesn't care about the chess piece's life and death is more terrifying than a black hole. "
Jiang Liuyun picked up the tea cup again and looked past the floor-to-ceiling windows of the conference hall, through the clouds and the void, and landed in a very distant darkness that was not marked by any star map. He didn't say it out loud, but he came to the same conclusion as Amu - the Black Hole Forest Spirit was just an abandoned child. The real opponent is still hidden in the deeper darkness.
